events.info: Celebrating 35 years as one of the most influential R&B groups of all time, JODECI established themselves as a trendsetting force throughout the culture with their signature style, soulful harmonies, and chart-topping hits. Throughout their historic career JODECI has sold over 20 million records worldwide, achieved five #1 hits, ten Top 10 hits, and three #1 albums on the Billboard charts, as well as countless wins and nominations from the Soul Train Music Awards, American Music Awards, BET Music Awards, and Billboard Music Awards. Their debut album Forever My Lady (1991) was a huge success reaching #1 on the Billboard Top R&B Albums chart in its first week of release, and featured the hit single, ?Forever My Lady,? which climbed to #1 on the Billboard Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Singles and Tracks chart. Ruling the charts for an unprecedented 49 weeks, the album?s classic hits ?Come & Talk To Me,? and ?Stay,? also topped the charts reaching #1 on the Billboard Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs chart.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Lyric Theatre does not have a full-time box office. The on-site box office opens 1 hour before showtime for most events. Advance tickets may be purchased at Ticketmaster.com.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call is only available beginning 1 hour before that show. Will Call tickets may not be picked up at another event or when the box office is not open.

venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: The Floor level (1st level) is accessible and does not require any stairs for access. Wheelchair spaces are marked on the Floor level. Seating in the Loge, Opera Boxes, and Balcony requires stairs for access. There is not an elevator in the Lyric Theatre. By purchasing seats in these sections you agree that you will take stairs to that area. The Lyric Theatre cannot guarantee that you can be seated in another section if you are unable to use stairs.

generalInfo.generalRule: Tickets sold as General Admission do not have assigned seats and are first come, first served. Your ticket may say General Admission, GENADM, or GA to signify General Admission. A number on a General Admission Ticket is not a seat number. Wheelchair accessible seating is not assigned for General Admission vents and is first come, first served. No weapons of any kind are allowed in the Lyric Theatre. All guests will be scanned with a metal detector wand and bags will be checked before entry to the building. No outside food or drink is allowed.
generalInfo.childRule: Children ages 2 and under do not need a ticket for most shows. This policy may vary for events designed for children. Please check the event listing for more specific information.
